item.title: Yellow City Rundown Feb. 23-27: Xcel Energy lawsuit, AC audit, Ranger Road fire
item.description: On this episode of the Yellow City Rundown for the week of Feb. 23-27, we focus on updates regarding the lawsuit involving Xcel Energy, an update on the Amarillo College independent audit, and we talked to a family who lost their home in the Ranger Road fire.

item.title: Sheppard AFB airman sentenced to life in prison on child sexual abuse charges
item.description: The United States Attorney's Office for the Northern District of Texas announced that a Sheppard Air Force Base Airman was sentenced to life in federal prison for sexually abusing a child.

item.title: Goodwill set to host job fair in Amarillo on March 3
item.description: Officials with Goodwill Industries of Northwest Texas announced that it will host a job fair next week.

item.title: Kids Inc. partners with NFL Flag Football League, registration opens March 23
item.description: Officials with Kids Inc. announced that it is partnering with the West Texas NFL Flag Football League to create a flag football program, expanding its reach to more than 2,500 young athletes in the Texas Panhandle.

item.title: Relief fund applications open for people affected by Ranger Road Fire
item.description: Today, Beaver County Emergency Management announced that applications for victims of the Ranger Road fire are now available.

item.title: President Trump touts oil and gas production in Texas visit
item.description: President Donald Trump touched down on Texas soil for the second time since returning to the White House.

item.title: Amarillo Public Health's Women's Health Clinic nearing one year, aims to reach more patients
item.description: The Women's Health Clinic at Amarillo Public Health is approaching its first anniversary after opening in April 2025, with leaders saying they hope to reach more women across the Panhandle in the coming year.

item.title: Clovis man convicted of felony murder in 2023 shooting
item.description: A Clovis man has been found guilty of felony murder and other charges in connection with a 2023 shooting that left a roofer dead, according to Ninth Judicial District Attorney Quentin Ray.

item.title: Wildfires cause evacuations, impact traffic across the Texas Panhandle, Oklahoma, Kansas
item.description: During critically dry and high-wind conditions on Tuesday, multiple wildfires sparked across communities in portions of the Texas Panhandle, Oklahoma and Kansas, causing a range of evacuations, warnings and road closures.
